verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents controls over which events count toward the event quota, plus a choice between 'capture every event' and 'rate limiting' for daily quota overages, so overage behavior can be capped. Dashboard discard rules synced to SDKs also cut event volume during an error storm. The evidence does not show per-project quota caps or an explicit dollar spend limit; missing for 10: documented per-project event quota caps, explicit spend/billing limit settings, independent or hands-on corroboration that rate limiting prevents surprise invoices.
